summary: A Reddit contact moved the conversation to Discord and guided a beginner through Trust Wallet and crypto staking while maintaining contact for several months. After the user accumulated about 8000 dollars in BTC ETH and SOL the assets were transferred from the wallet to unknown addresses without the users intentional action.
user_mistake: trusted an unknown online contact with detailed information about wallet activity and holdings
prevention: Keep wallet activity and holdings private from unsolicited investment contacts / Stop using a wallet if an unknown adviser has influenced its setup or staking process
classification_warning: insufficient detail to identify compromise vector
